text: An integrated approach toward capital planning incorporates not only the immediate needs of an organization, but its long-term goals, and includes variables such as the optimal cost of capitat organizational strategic initiatives requiring investment, desired rating category, and asset liability management.

name: CSM Model definition
text: Our Capital Structure Management (CSM) Model is the central tool used in providing this service. The CSM model is a proprietary Monte Carlo simulation-based capital struchlring and optimization system developed specifically for the complex needs of the firm's largest and most prestigious corporate, tax-exempt and sovereign clients.

name: Internal use of CSM Model
text: Goldman Sachs also uses the model internally to evaluate debt and investment strategies.

name: Optimal portfolio planning
text: Our model provides CFOs and Treasurers with a plan for constructing optimal debt and investment portfolios based upon their cost/risk objectives and existing constraints.

name: Assistance to Presbyterian
text: The model can assist Presbyterian in determining the type of debt to issue (e.g., maturity, call/put features, fixed versus floating), the exposure of Presbyterian's overall liabilities to movements in interest rates, the impact of derivative securities such as swaps, as well as optimal refunding strategies for existing debt issues.

name: Investment and pension-liability capability
